summary: The customer called because their monthly bill increased unexpectedly from sixty to ninety-five dollars due to an expired promotional rate and an automatic contract renewal. The agent explained the renewal terms, apologized for the communication gap, and offered a loyalty credit to reduce the new bill to eighty dollars per month. The customer accepted the loyalty credit and the call concluded.

evidence.text: I'll apply the loyalty credit right now, and it will reflect on your next billing cycle.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Apply a fifteen dollar monthly loyalty credit to the customer's account effective on the next billing cycle.

evidence.text: I can certainly look into that bill for you and see why the charges have increased.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, respectful, and helpful tone throughout the entire call.

evidence.text: I completely understand your frustration, and I want to help you find the best solution possible without adding extra charges.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent actively acknowledged the customer's frustration regarding the bill increase and offered a constructive solution.

evidence.text: Alright, I suppose I don't have much of a choice then. Let's go ahead with that eighty-dollar option, please.
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully addressed the customer's billing concern and provided an acceptable compromise via a loyalty credit.

evidence.text: What I mean is that the discount you had for the first year has ended, so the price went up to our regular monthly rate.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained technical terms clearly when asked to repeat and simplify the explanation.

evidence.text: Is there anything else I can clarify for you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly checked for additional questions, summarized the resolution, and closed the call politely.

evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately explained account terms, expiration of promotions, and the loyalty credit options.
